notes: *even* marked `added` on rule 105's substantival-article-carrier arm rather than folded onto ὁ, matching 23:10.

ὁ before οὐράνιος keeps *he who*: its modifier carries no verb of its own, so rule 31's carve-out leaves the relativizer with the article, and rule 92's clause gives it the separate antecedent pronoun; the adjective takes the supplied copula with its recast predicate (rule 53), headed on *heaven* as the word glossing the root.
*no man* kept whole on μή headed on *no* (rules 17, 69); reading *man* as a supplied object folded onto καλέσητε under rule 74 remains defensible.
